name: Skeletal animation core: skeleton, clips, blending and state machine
body: Dean (2026-11-17): animation is one of the main needs, so the player and companion read as grounded partners. Engine side in Nox under `lantern:::animation:::`: a Skeleton (joint tree with bind pose), Clips (per-joint position, rotation and scale keys, sampled and slerped), Pose blending (crossfade, 1D blend by a parameter, per-joint masks) and an Animator with named states, parameters and transitions. Pure CPU maths with tests. Decisions in docs/decisions.md and docs/animation.md.
